confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and bar prices are moderately certain, but Tulum varies widely between the town centre and the beach-club zone, so the midpoint may fit neither well. Accommodation is least certain and July is shoulder season after the Christmas peak. The FX rate comes from rba.gov.au search-result snippets, not from opening the RBA page directly. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor (roughly 2.2x beer) because direct knowledge is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Mexican Caribbean coast, mainly Playa del Carmen and Cancun, adjusted to Tulum's pricier beach-zone and boutique-hotel mix, blended with the lower-cost Tulum town centre.
